children: Thailand's economic data in July points toward a sequential 3Q recovery, BofA Global Research economists say in a report. Growth slowed to 1.9% on year in 2Q, from 1Q's 2.8% expansion, amid rising energy prices. However, the economy improved on the demand and production side in July, driven by the ongoing artificial intelligence capital expenditure cycle, the easing Middle East conflict and government stimulus measures. Still, BofA warns that the growth recovery could be subdued, as many economic activities are import-intensive and would weigh on the current account and trade balance.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
